MORE TIPS HERE 🖤 - Use the colours that are in the trousers as a baseline for your colour pattern, if the stripes on the sides are pink for example, try something pink to match on top! OR go for a complimentary colour on top, like burgundy and butter yellow, blue and red, pink and green etc.  - Shoe wise I’d personally go for Adidas Samba’s or a loafer. I’d personally stray away from ‘dad sneakers’ or heels underneath this.  - Add accessories OFCOURSE! You can truly level up these fits by adding hats, caps, bandana’s, statement jewellery or even cute hairdo’s like breads or space buns, your look will instantly feel way more put together.  - Since it’s currently still cold in the UK, jacket wise I’d suggest one of the contrasting textures I suggested in the video, a (lined) denim jacket or leather coat would look great, but also, adding a contrasting vibe such as a trench coat!  Let me know in the comments if there are any other pieces of clothing you find hard to style ⭐️ #adidas #adidastrackpants #adidasfirebird #adidastrousers
